decisions.reason: The existing inventory already identifies the panel buttons, switch, reset, and touch inputs as connector-based interfaces and does not list BOOT as a panel connector; the clarification requires no state change.
The source clarifies physical mounting and connection mode but does not change any GPIO assignment.
Button mounting and connector use do not change the main-board decoupling requirement.
The source does not address I2C series resistors, topology, or signal conditioning.
The panel-button connection clarification does not alter the INA219 or monitored rail.
The source concerns mechanical connection of buttons and does not change addressable-LED power, switching, or logic-level handling.
The source does not affect power-source OR-ing, diode selection, or source-selection behavior.
Panel-button mounting and connector mode do not change standalone USB power or sensor-debugging support.
The clarification applies to main-board panel buttons and does not affect the power-board battery connector.
The source concerns panel-control connectors, not the separate power and signal links between boards.
The statement about buttons does not change the charge-status LED chain, connector, GPIO, or associated component values.
The main-board button connection clarification is unrelated to the power-board AXP2101 topology.
